
# Check the Workflow

```{r}
library(timelinesr)

## 1. IDENTIFY LOCATIONS
timeline_json <- "Timelines/hvnp_timeline.json"
photo_folder  <- "Test_Photos/"

## 2. INGEST THE TIMELINE

timeline <- timelinesr::read_timeline("Timelines/hvnp_timeline.json")

## 3. FUSE TIMELINE DATA
track <- timelinesr::fuse_layers(timeline, max_accuracy = 1000)

## 4. LOAD PHOTOS 
photos <- timelinesr::get_photo_timestamps(photo_folder) 

## 5. GET THE TIMELINE-PHOTO MATCH
tagged <- timelinesr::geotag_photos(track, photos)

## 6. CHECK THE RESULTS
head(tagged,20)

## 7. WRITE LOCATIONS TO THE PHOTOS 
## timelinesr::write_geotags(tagged)

## 8. VISUALIZE ON A MAP
timelinesr::visualize_geotags(tagged)

####################################

library(timelinesr)

## 0. IDENTIFY LOCATIONS
timeline_json <- "Timelines/hvnp_timeline.json"
photo_folder  <- "Test_Photos/"
voronoi_places <- "HVNP_photo_places.csv"

# 1. Fuse and Clean
timeline <- timelinesr::read_timeline(timeline_json)
track_raw <- timelinesr::fuse_layers(timeline, max_accuracy = 20)
track_clean <- timelinesr::clean_track(track_raw)

# 2. Extract Photos
photos <- timelinesr::get_photo_timestamps(photo_folder)

# 3. Geotag (TIGHTEN THE GAP TO 15 MINUTES!)
tagged <- timelinesr::geotag_photos(track_clean, photos, max_gap_mins = 15)

# 4. Apply Hybrid Assignment (Pass in the track_clean as the 2nd argument)
tagged_final <- timelinesr::assign_places(tagged, track_clean, voronoi_places)

# 5. Map it!
timelinesr::visualize_geotags(tagged_final)
 
```
